entities.summary: Zuhres or Zugres is a city in Khartsyzk urban hromada, Donetsk Raion, Donetsk Oblast in Ukraine. The city has a population of 17,871. It is currently occupied by Russia and forces of the de facto Donetsk People's Republic.
